title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Beacon Theatre, New York City | 2017
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Beacon Theatre in New York City, USA, on 15 November 2017.

It was the penultimate show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s US tour, which lasted for 21 dates in October and November 2017.

Starr had previously performed at the Beacon Theatre on 16 and 17 February 1999, 23 May 2000, and 17 and 18 June 2014. He returned there on 6, 7, and 8 June 2022.

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, percussion, keyboards, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums
